zh.title: 偵察紀錄：把觀察與推論分開
zh.summary: 蒐集資訊的價值在於改善下一個問題。用來源、時間與信心，把零散線索整理成可以驗證的假設。
objectives: 區分對目標的主動互動與既有資料的閱讀。
把一筆 DNS 線索寫成有界線的發現。

sections.heading: 先決定你需要知道什麼
paragraphs: 偵察（Reconnaissance）用來建立資產、服務與組織關係的初步圖像。問題可以很小：這個名稱曾指向哪個服務？資料更新到什麼時候？答案應縮小不確定性，而不是把所有能找到的個人資訊都收集起來。
閱讀已提供的資料表不會直接接觸目標；直接向目標服務送請求則會留下互動。被稱為「被動」的方法也可能透過第三方產生查詢紀錄，所以應記錄實際資料來源與動作，不只貼上 active 或 passive 標籤。

sections.heading: 名稱對應不是所有權證明
paragraphs: DNS 用分散式名稱系統提供資源紀錄。A／AAAA 紀錄提供位址，CNAME 提供別名關係。這些回答支援名稱解析，但不單獨證明系統的管理權、版本或測試授權。共享代管環境尤其容易把「相同位址」誤認成「同一個資產」。
一筆可用紀錄至少分成 observation、inference、next check。保留時間很重要：過去的解析結果不一定代表現在的配置。下一個檢查仍需落在 M01 的授權範圍。

example.title: 例子：兩個名稱指向同一位址
example.scenario: 一份提供給你的合成清單顯示，docs.example.test 與 shop.example.test 在 09:00 都指向 192.0.2.10。
example.reasoning: 可以觀察到同一時刻的位址相同，並提出「可能共用代管或前端」的假設。不能直接推導同一後端、同一管理者，或商店也在已授權的文件站範圍內。
example.conclusion: 先把假設交給資產清單與授權人核對；暫不對新名稱測試。

lab.title: 紙上練習：三欄證據卡
lab.environment: 只使用本文的合成 DNS 紀錄，不查詢真實網域。
steps: 在「推論」寫一個可能解釋，再列出一個反例。
在「下一步」寫明要找誰確認所有權與測試範圍。
lab.expected: 反例可以是不同客戶共用同一個 CDN 或反向代理位址；下一步是核對範圍，不是直接掃描。
lab.check: 若把「可能共用前端」改成「已證明同一後端」，缺了什麼證據？
lab.cleanup: 保存合成證據卡；沒有網路或檔案需要清理。

en.title: Reconnaissance notes: separate observation from inference
en.summary: Information gathering is useful when it improves the next question. Record source, time and confidence to turn scattered clues into testable hypotheses.
objectives: Distinguish direct target interaction from reading existing material.
Write a bounded finding from a DNS clue.

sections.heading: Decide what you need to know
paragraphs: Reconnaissance builds an initial picture of assets, services and relationships. A question can be narrow: which service did this name point to, and when was that recorded? The answer should reduce uncertainty, not justify collecting every available personal detail.

Reading a supplied dataset does not directly contact the target; sending requests to its service does. A method called passive may still create query records at a third party. Record the actual source and action rather than relying only on an active or passive label.

sections.heading: Name resolution is not ownership evidence
paragraphs: DNS distributes resource records through a naming system. A and AAAA records provide addresses; CNAME provides an alias relationship. These answers support name resolution, but do not independently establish administration, software version or testing permission. Shared hosting makes it especially easy to confuse the same address with the same asset.

A useful note separates observation, inference and next check. Time matters because an earlier resolution may not represent the current configuration. The next check still needs to fit the authorization established in M01.

example.title: Example: two names share an address
example.scenario: A supplied synthetic list says docs.example.test and shop.example.test both pointed to 192.0.2.10 at 09:00.
example.reasoning: You can observe a shared address at that time and hypothesize shared hosting or a front end. You cannot infer the same backend, administrator or permission to test the shop from authorization for the documentation site.
example.conclusion: Check the hypothesis against the asset inventory and authorizer before testing the additional name.

lab.title: Tabletop exercise: a three-column evidence card
lab.environment: Use only the synthetic DNS records in this lesson; do not query real domains.
steps: Record both names, 192.0.2.10 and 09:00 under Observation.
Under Inference, write a possible explanation and one counterexample.
Under Next check, name the role that must confirm ownership and scope.
lab.expected: A counterexample is different customers sharing a CDN or reverse-proxy address. The next action is scope verification, not an immediate scan.
lab.check: What evidence is missing if “may share a front end” becomes “proven to share a backend”?
lab.cleanup: Save the synthetic evidence card. No network or system cleanup is needed.

zh.prompt: 兩個名稱解析到同一個 IP，能直接推論什麼？
options: 一定同一管理者
兩者都已授權測試
該次紀錄的位址相同
一定同一作業系統
rationales: 共享代管可以有不同管理者。
解析資訊不提供測試授權。
這是資料直接支持的觀察。
位址不能證明後端作業系統相同。

en.prompt: Two names resolve to the same IP. What follows directly?
options: They must share an administrator
Both are authorized test targets
Their addresses match in that observation
They must run the same OS
rationales: Shared hosting can have different administrators.
Resolution data does not grant permission.
This is directly supported by the record.
An address does not establish a shared backend OS.

options: 來源、時間、原始觀察、推論及下一步
只寫「這台有問題」
只存一張沒有日期的圖片
把猜測直接當事實
rationales: 這些欄位讓別人能追溯資料與判斷。
沒有對象與證據。
日期與資料脈絡缺失。
混淆事實與推論會放大錯誤。

en.prompt: Which note is easiest to verify later?
options: Source, time, observation, inference and next check
Only “this host has a problem”
Only an undated image
Treat a guess as a fact
rationales: These fields let another reader trace the evidence and reasoning.
The target and evidence are unspecified.
Time and context are missing.
Conflating facts and inferences compounds errors.

zh.prompt: CNAME 的別名關係是否自動擴充測試範圍？
options: 是，因為 DNS 是公開資訊
否，仍需核對授權資產與動作
是，只要名稱看起來相關
否，所有 DNS 都不能閱讀
rationales: 公開與授權不同。
技術關係不能取代授權範圍。
名稱相似不是授權證據。
問題是範圍，不是全面禁止閱讀 DNS。

en.prompt: Does a CNAME alias automatically extend test scope?
options: Yes, because DNS is public
No; authorized assets and actions still need checking
Yes, if the names look related
No, because DNS can never be read
rationales: Public visibility and authorization differ.
A technical relationship does not replace explicit scope.
Similar names are not authorization evidence.
The issue is scope, not a blanket ban on reading DNS.
